# BasePay

> Free UK financial education through interactive lessons and a simulator that uses pretend money.

## Public pages

- [BasePay homepage](https://basepay.org.uk/): Start free in the browser or sign in to continue a saved simulation.
- [BasePay guide](https://basepay.org.uk/basepay.md): Text overview of the lessons, simulator, guest access and save files.
- [Privacy](https://basepay.org.uk/privacy.md): Text version of the privacy page, including account storage and optional analytics.
